# function: ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token

Builds the ARN for `ec2` `ipam-external-resource-verification-token`:

```
arn:${Partition}:ec2::${Account}:ipam-external-resource-verification-token/${IpamExternalResourceVerificationTokenId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:ec2::111111111111:ipam-external-resource-verification-token/ipam-external-resource-verification-token-id
output "ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token" {
  value = provider::arn::ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token("ipam-external-resource-verification-token-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
ec2_ipam_external_resource_verification_token(ipam_external_resource_verification_token_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `ipam_external_resource_verification_token_id` (String) Value for `${IpamExternalResourceVerificationTokenId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
